attributes.action: Ask the FA to improve England team preparation with year-round training camps
attributes.additional_details: England's national football teams usually spend most of the year with their clubs and only come together for short international breaks and tournaments. We believe more regular training camps would improve teamwork, tactics and preparation, giving England a better chance of success in major competitions. We want the Government to work with The Football Association to explore ways of increasing national team preparation time.
attributes.background: We want the Government to work with The Football Association to increase England's national football team training time throughout the year, so players are better prepared for international competitions.
